name: js_temperature_converter
prompt:
Fix the JavaScript temperature converter bug.

Requirements:
- Modify converter.js only.
- convertCelsius must reject values below absolute zero (celsius < -273.15).
- convertCelsius must reject unknown target units.
- Valid conversions must return the correct value (C -> F, C -> K, C -> C).
- Rejected inputs must throw an Error.
- Do not modify main.js or units.js.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only convertCelsius changes.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: node main.js
